design.recommendation: A server-bound typed read port on the existing pure materializer, implemented by the existing route; four files only.
design.port: Return a tagged legacy-slot / signed-mission / refused context from SERVER reads. The route supplies fresh accepted records, durable current memberships/claims and campaign/session binding; no context field is parsed from request owner/player/slot/contribution data.
design.signedMode: Use signed mode when a live campaign entry exists or a per-mission durable claim names a non-placeholder owner. Missing/closed/wrong-campaign registry or missing/stale accepted choices then refuses; do not fall back to legacy. With no live entry and only legitimate creation/per-mission placeholder claims, retain the existing slot-based path. Pure existing callers without the optional server context retain their current slot-based behavior.
design.validation: Check original expected head and existing progression first. In signed mode require mission existence, exact campaign/session binding, fresh accepted record coverage for active tactical members, record/claim agreement, one force per contributor as P1A, no extra signed claim, active matching membership, exact current force/unit membership and resolvable source references. Refuse conflicting/duplicate owners/units and empty deployed union. Read durable state consistently without writes. P1A still re-admits at create; preflight is not a reservation.

design.replayAndConcurrency: Repeated preflight is read-only; cold loss of accepted participation refuses until genuine signed choices are accepted again. Capture no-append census.
